title: Jonathan Jackson Stock Trades: Estee Lauder, Datadog, Walmart and More (Oct 2026)
content:
Rep. Jonathan Jackson (IL-1) disclosed five stock trades on October 19, 2026, all dated September 28: purchases of Estee Lauder, Datadog and Guardant Health, and sales of Walmart and ViaSat. Four of the five were in the $50,001–$100,000 band.

Trade data: Bargo, compiled from U.S. House and Senate STOCK Act filings.

Sep 28VSATViaSat, Inc.Sale, $50,001–$100,000$71.65 vs. $78.26 (+9.23%)
Sep 28WMTWalmart Inc.Sale, $50,001–$100,000$108.73 vs. $118.77 (+9.23%)
Sep 28GHGuardant Health, Inc.Purchase, $15,001–$50,000$177.33 vs. $182.59 (+2.97%)

Transaction date for all five: Sep 28, 2026. Disclosure date: Oct 19, 2026 (21 days later). Member: Rep. Jonathan Jackson, IL-1 (House).

What's been disclosed

  • Three purchases: Estee Lauder (EL) and Datadog (DDOG) at $50,001–$100,000 each, and Guardant Health (GH) at $15,001–$50,000.
  • Two sales: Walmart (WMT) and ViaSat (VSAT), each $50,001–$100,000.
  • Price since: Bargo's estimate puts all five stocks higher on October 28 than on September 28, from +2.97% (Guardant Health) to +14.38% (Estee Lauder).

Quick FAQ

How long after the trades were they disclosed?
21 days after the trades, which were all dated September 28. The STOCK Act gives members 45 days from the transaction to disclose it.

Why are the amounts ranges?
Filings report value bands such as $15,001–$50,000 instead of exact dollar amounts.

Where does the price comparison come from?
It is Bargo's estimate, comparing the price on the transaction date with the October 28 price. It is not the member's actual execution price.
